description:
"Conjure icy shards at the target location to skewer enemies in the area, dealing |cffffff1025|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds. This damage increases by |cffffff30|r% if cast with a Destruction Staff equipped.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

This ability has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect."
